vetHelp.title: Veterinary Help & Emergency Directory
vetHelp.subtitle: Quick access to veterinary officers, helplines and emergency first-aid guidelines
vetHelp.emergencyBannerSub: For acute bloat, severe bleeding, difficulty breathing or sudden collapse, call a veterinarian immediately.
vetHelp.tipBloatText: Stop all feed immediately, keep the animal standing on an incline with front legs higher, walk gently, and call a veterinarian urgently.
vetHelp.tipFeverText: Isolate the animal in a cool, shaded, well-ventilated shed. Provide clean drinking water and avoid giving human medicines without veterinary advice.
vetHelp.tipWoundText: Wash gently with clean water and dilute antiseptic (potassium permanganate or povidone-iodine). Keep flies away and consult a vet.

reasons.tempAboveRange: Body temperature {{temp}}°C is above the usual range (over {{limit}}°C)

alerts.mildAfternoonTemp: Mild afternoon temperature rise ({{temp}}°C) after heat exposure
alerts.reasonCriticalBaseline: Temperature ({{temp}}°C) is critically above {{name}}'s recorded baseline ({{baseline}}°C) and species limit ({{limit}}°C).
alerts.reasonCriticalSafe: Temperature ({{temp}}°C) is critically above the safe range ({{limit}}°C).
alerts.reasonElevatedBaseline: Temperature rose to {{temp}}°C compared to {{name}}'s baseline of {{baseline}}°C ({{delta}}°C).
alerts.reasonElevatedThreshold: Temperature ({{temp}}°C) is above the normal species threshold ({{limit}}°C).
alerts.reasonDeltaBaseline: Temperature ({{temp}}°C) is {{delta}}°C higher than {{name}}'s individual baseline ({{baseline}}°C).
alerts.reasonGauri: Temperature is above the animal's recorded baseline (38.5°C → 39.8°C, +1.3°C) and appetite has reduced. This change requires attention. Monitor the animal and contact a veterinarian for assessment.
alerts.reasonLakshmi: Slight afternoon rise above 38.5°C baseline after summer grazing; appetite remained Normal.
alerts.reasonStoppedEating: Animal has stopped eating (No appetite recorded).
alerts.reasonAppetiteDropped: Appetite dropped from Normal to Reduced.
alerts.reasonAppetiteDroppedLow: Appetite dropped from Normal to Low and activity level is reduced.
alerts.reasonReducedActivity: Animal is showing reduced physical activity.
alerts.reasonWeightDecreased: Body weight decreased from {{prev}} kg to {{curr}} kg (-{{pct}}%).
alerts.actionHigh: Isolate the animal in a comfortable shaded area, check water intake, and contact a veterinarian promptly for clinical assessment.
alerts.actionMedium: Monitor body temperature and appetite closely every 4–6 hours. Contact a veterinarian if observations do not normalize within 24 hours.
alerts.actionMediumHooves: Monitor body temperature and appetite closely every 4–6 hours. Check hooves and grazing comfort.
alerts.actionLow: Continue routine observation and record a follow-up check tomorrow.
alerts.actionLowWater: Provide cool drinking water and shade; recheck temperature in the evening.

digitalTwin.title: Animal Digital Twin
digitalTwin.subtitle: Individual digital health profile, historical baseline comparison and real-time trend intelligence
digitalTwin.healthScoreDisclaimer: Illustrative application indicator (0–100) derived from logged observations — NOT a medical score or diagnosis.
digitalTwin.baselineDisclaimer: Baseline comparisons highlight changes from this animal's past readings. They do NOT diagnose disease.
digitalTwin.buildingBaselineSub: At least {{min}} historical observations are required before generating an individual baseline.
digitalTwin.tempChartTitle: Historical Body Temperature vs Personal Baseline (°C)
digitalTwin.tempChartSub: Compares recorded temperature readings against the animal's individual baseline
digitalTwin.weightChartSub: Historical body weight (kg) and appetite observations
digitalTwin.milkChartSub: Recent daily milk yield compared with individual baseline
digitalTwin.noAlertsForAnimal: No early warning alerts recorded for this animal.

earlyWarning.title: Early Health Warning System
earlyWarning.subtitle: Automated baseline & veterinary threshold deviation alerts with explainable reasons and follow-up tracking
earlyWarning.disclaimer: Risk levels (Low, Medium, High) indicate observation priority based on baseline changes and simple thresholds — they are NOT disease probabilities or confirmed diagnoses. For High risk or severe signs, contact a veterinarian promptly.
earlyWarning.noAlertsText: When a new health observation deviates from an animal's baseline or safe thresholds, an explainable alert will appear here.
earlyWarning.followUpNotePlaceholder: e.g. Rechecked temperature after 4 hours; animal drank water and is resting in shade...
